==Ingredients==
*2 large scoops of orange [[Cookbook:Ice Cream#Sherbet|sherbet]]
*1 large scoop of [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|vanilla ice cream]]
*6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (170 g) Dr. Pepper (or equivalent) [[Cookbook:Soda|soda]]
*1 large squeeze of [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate syrup]]
*Dash of [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]] juice
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] (optional)

==Procedure==
#Combine all the ingredients in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]].
#Blend until mixture is thin enough to pour out of blender into a glass.
#Enjoy with a spoon and/or soda straw.
